title: Alcandrus
summary: Alcandrus is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

standby.note: Standby placement only, placed with "Fall of Troy" (a linked event of this person's life). The year is that record's sort year, taken as-is. No reign length or age was added or subtracted. It is not a sort year.

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.date: “Alcandrus, 7 years, in whose time Ilion, (i.e., Troy), was taken”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 120; Manetho, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 59 to 75, and Eusebius, Chronicle 15 to 17
reign.note: The seven years and the fall of Ilion are one sentence. Thuoris, the previous name, is given no length and is not given this synchronism.
